title: Home Purchase Financing Fee Note — Repeat Payoff Statements
content:
**Fee schedule note — repeat payoff statements on Home Purchase Financing loans**

Where two or more payoff statements were issued on the loan in the 12 whole months before the statement date, the statement fee is 30.00; where exactly one was issued in those 12 months, the statement fee is 15.00. Where none was issued in those 12 months, this note sets no repeat statement fee.

The statement fee is the fee included in the payoff amount of the statement being issued. The statements counted are the earlier payoff statements recorded among the loan's notices, by their dates.

| Payoff statements issued in the 12 whole months before the statement date | Statement fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 30.00 |
| exactly 1 | 15.00 |
| none | not set by this note |

*Hypothetical cases (statement date 2026-05-04).* Earlier statements dated 2026-01-12 and 2026-03-30: two in the period, 30.00. A single earlier statement dated 2025-09-08: 15.00. A single earlier statement dated 2025-04-20, more than 12 whole months before: none in the period.
